sam: FYI ran a quick kNN stability test on the new sem-embed-3b quant build. recall@10 dropped ~3.2% on NQ holdout vs float16, and I'm seeing more nearest-neighbor ID flips for high-sim pairs.

kai: can you paste the eval command and seed?

sam: `./eval/knn.py --model sem-embed-3b --quant int8 --dataset natural_questions --k 10 --seed 42`
Gave top-level numbers: float16 r@10 78.4 -> int8 (per-tensor) 75.2

nora: interesting — was that per-tensor or per-channel quantization? per-tensor often causes global scale shifts.

sam: per-tensor. I also re-ran with per-channel and gap shrank to ~1.1% (r@10 77.3)

eval-bot: [auto-report] silhouette: float16 0.42 | int8-per-tensor 0.34 | int8-per-channel 0.40; mean angular error increased by 0.012 rad

kai: can you share a small sample of the id-flips and cluster purity? also run a pairwise cosine histogram to see where mass shifts.

sam: uploaded sample gist: https://gist.github.com/placeholder-sample — shows ~124/10k top1 swaps concentrated on very short queries (<6 tokens)

zach: short queries often have higher norm variance — did you L2-normalize embeddings after quantized forward? sometimes a simple postnorm fixes ranking.

sam: tried L2 postnorm: recall@10 for int8-per-tensor -> 76.1, int8-per-channel -> 77.6. Still not back to fp16 but much better.

nora: schedule a 3-seed sweep across NQ and MS MARCO holdouts, and generate UMAPs to inspect cluster breakouts. if per-channel + postnorm is consistently within 1% we can consider onboarding with a note.

sam: kicking off sweep (job 9832). ETA ~2h. tagging @eng-ml for awareness :eyes:

kai: ping me if any job OOMs or fails, I'll help debug.

sam: job finished. final aggregated numbers: float16 r@10 78.4 | int8-per-channel+postnorm 77.8 | int8-per-tensor+postnorm 76.5. pairwise id-flip rate: fp16 0.9% -> int8-per-channel+postnorm 1.4%.

nora: that's acceptable for many customers. please add an explicit note in the model card recommending per-channel quant + postnorm and include the id-flip artifact, plus the UMAP images and pairwise histogram.

sam: will update model_card.md and open PR with eval artifacts and gifs.

zach: :thumbsup:
